topics.title: Page 1
topics.context:
8 References

This section is informative.

8.1 General References

[A-130] OMB Circular A-130, Managing Federal Information as a Strategic Resource, July 28, 2016, available at: https://obamawhitehouse.archives.gov/sites/default/files/omb/assets/OMB/circulars/a130/a130revised.pdf.

[EO 13681] Executive Order 13681, Improving the Security of Consumer Financial Transactions, October 17, 2014, available at: https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2014-25439.

[ESIG] Federal CIO Council, Use of Electronic Signatures in Federal Organization Transactions, January 25, 2013, available at: https://cio.gov/wp-content/uploads/downloads/2014/03/Use_of_ESignatures_in_Federal_Agency_Transactions_v1-0_20130125.pdf.

[FISMA] Federal Information Security Modernization Act of 2014, available at: https://www.congress.gov/bill/113th-congress/senate-bill/2521.

[HSPD-12] Department of Homeland Security, Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12: Policy for a Common Identification Standard for Federal Employees and Contractors, August 27, 2004, available at: https://www.dhs.gov/homeland-security-presidential-directive-12.

[M-03-22] OMB Memorandum M-03-22, OMB Guidance for Implementing the Privacy Provisions of the E-Government Act of 2002, September 26, 2003, available at: https://georgewbush-whitehouse.archives.gov/omb/memoranda/m03-22.html.

[M-04-04] OMB Memorandum M-04-04, E-Authentication Guidance for Federal Agencies, December 16, 2003, available at: https://georgewbush-whitehouse.archives.gov/omb/memoranda/fy04/m04-04.pdf.

[NISTIR8062] NIST Internal Report 8062, An Introduction to Privacy Engineering and Risk Management in Federal Systems, January 2017, available at: http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ir/2017/NIST.IR.8062.pdf.

[NIST RMF] Risk Management Framework Overview, available at http://csrc.nist.gov/groups/SMA/fisma/framework.html.

[RFC 5280] IETF, Internet X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Certificate and CRL Profile, RFC 5280, DOI 10.17487/RFC5280, May 2008, https://doi.org/10.17487/RFC5280.

[Steiner] Steiner, Peter. “On the Internet, nobody knows you’re a dog”, The New Yorker, July 5, 1993.

sentiment.summary: Informative reference section listing federal documents.

faqs.question: ¿Qué es el OMB Circular A-130 y dónde puedo encontrarlo?
faqs.answer: El OMB Circular A-130, titulado "Managing Federal Information as a Strategic Resource", fue publicado el 28 de julio de 2016 y está disponible en https://obamawhitehouse.archives.gov/sites/default/files/omb/assets/OMB/circulars/a130/a130revised.pdf.

faqs.question: ¿Qué trata el Executive Order 13681?
faqs.answer: El Executive Order 13681, titulado "Improving the Security of Consumer Financial Transactions", fue emitido el 17 de octubre de 2014 y se puede consultar en https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2014-25439.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es el propósito del documento ESIG del Federal CIO Council?
faqs.answer: El documento ESIG, titulado "Use of Electronic Signatures in Federal Organization Transactions", fue publicado el 25 de enero de 2013 y está disponible en https://cio.gov/wp-content/uploads/downloads/2014/03/Use_of_ESignatures_in_Federal_Agency_Transactions_v1-0_20130125.pdf.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde puedo leer el Federal Information Security Modernization Act de 2014?
faqs.answer: El Federal Information Security Modernization Act de 2014 se encuentra en https://www.congress.gov/bill/113th-congress/senate-bill/2521.

faqs.question: ¿Qué información contiene el HSPD-12?
faqs.answer: El HSPD-12, titulado "Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12: Policy for a Common Identification Standard for Federal Employees and Contractors", fue emitido el 27 de agosto de 2004 y está disponible en https://www.dhs.gov/homeland-security-presidential-directive-12.

faqs.question: ¿Para qué sirve el Memorándum M-03-22 de OMB?
faqs.answer: El Memorándum M-03-22 de OMB, titulado "OMB Guidance for Implementing the Privacy Provisions of the E-Government Act of 2002", fue emitido el 26 de septiembre de 2003 y se puede consultar en https://georgewbush-whitehouse.archives.gov/omb/memoranda/m03-22.html.

faqs.question: ¿Qué cubre el Memorándum M-04-04 de OMB?
faqs.answer: El Memorándum M-04-04 de OMB, titulado "E-Authentication Guidance for Federal Agencies", fue emitido el 16 de diciembre de 2003 y está disponible en https://georgewbush-whitehouse.archives.gov/omb/memoranda/fy04/m04-04.pdf.

faqs.question: ¿Qué es el NIST Internal Report 8062?
faqs.answer: El NIST Internal Report 8062, titulado "An Introduction to Privacy Engineering and Risk Management in Federal Systems", fue publicado en enero de 2017 y se puede descargar en http://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ir/2017/NIST.IR.8062.pdf.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde puedo encontrar la descripción del Risk Management Framework de NIST?
faqs.answer: La descripción del Risk Management Framework de NIST está disponible en http://csrc.nist.gov/groups/SMA/fisma/framework.html.

faqs.question: ¿Qué especifica el RFC 5280?
faqs.answer: El RFC 5280, titulado "Internet X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Certificate and CRL Profile", fue publicado en mayo de 2008 y su DOI es 10.17487/RFC5280. Se puede acceder a través de https://doi.org/10.17487/RFC5280.

   - **NIST Internal Report 8062** (Introduction to Privacy Engineering and Risk Management, 2017) with a PDF link.

   - **RFC 5280** (Internet X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Certificate and CRL Profile, 2008) with DOI and URL.
   - A cultural reference: **Steiner, Peter**’s New Yorker article "On the Internet, nobody knows you’re a dog" (1993).

Each entry includes the citation label, title, date, and a hyperlink to the source.
